name: Apocalypse Tale
detailed_description:
By chance, you've traveled back 100 years in time and inherited a farm from a man named Anxi. Now, in this apocalyptic world, your first task is simple: learn to survive...

Features:

Survival

You will constantly face the threats of starvation and natural disasters. Remember—you must survive, or your property and life will be at risk.

Extreme Apocalypse Mode

Your survival situation will become even more challenging, and staying alive is your sole objective.

Farming

To survive, you must purchase seeds and grow crops on your farm for food or trade.

Plant Affection: Use tools to gently "pet" plants, calming their emotions to ensure healthy growth.

Symbiotic Growth: If identical crops are planted at different times, they will synchronize—all plants of the same type will mature together when the last one is ready.

More than 25 different crops

                                            

                                            

                                            

                      

More than 15 types of tools

                                        

                            

Chopping Wood

Purchase an axe to fell trees and earn money. If you manage to harvest rare species, your survival odds will improve significantly.

Mining

Equip a pickaxe to extract valuable ores from the mines—but beware, the depths are fraught with danger! Proceed with caution.

More than 15 types of ores

                                                        

        

Fishing

Head to riverbanks to catch mutated fish in this post-apocalyptic world. Keep moving along the shore to locate active fishing spots and increase your chances of a successful haul.

More than 20 catchable fish

                               

                                    

        

Grave Robbing

Venture into the mine tunnels to excavate ancient artifacts buried in the walls. These relics possess a strange vitality - you'll need to keep shifting positions to successfully uncover them before their spiritual energy repels you.

More than 20 antiques

                                        

                                

Part-Time Job

When short on cash, you can work at the factory assembly line—though the work will be exhausting and mind-numbingly repetitive.

Cloud Farming

Given the hazardous conditions, you can now cultivate certain creatures remotely through cloud-based husbandry to safely harvest materials.

Material Cultivation

You can obtain materials by slaying monsters or through cloud farming. Upgrade them further using Bio-Cultivators to produce enhanced variants.

Cultivator Calibration: Use tools to fine-tune the machine, ensuring stable operation and optimal yield.

Symbiotic Growth: Dark energy seeps into materials during cultivation, granting them faint sentience. If batches are processed at different times, they synchronize—all materials of the same type will finish simultaneously when the last one is complete.

Bounty Hunting

Completing monster bounties is a reliable way to earn cash—if you're strong enough to survive them.

Stock Trading

Buy low, sell high—play the market to grow your fortune.

Market Trading

Monitor daily price fluctuations at the exchange and sell goods at peak values. For contraband or premium items, the shadow market offers greater profits.

Skills

Over time, your skills will gradually improve. Leveling up your nine core skills - Farming, Crafting, Combat, Labor, Finance, Antiques, Logging, Mining, and Fishing - will increase the value of items you sell, enhance your capabilities, and unlock special abilities.

Manual

You can check information about all these aspects in the game's manual.

short_description: This is a post-apocalyptic survival farming game where you can plant crops, chop wood, fish, mine, trade, play the stock market—but most importantly, plan how to stay alive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows Vista or greater
  • Processor: 2 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 mb video memory, shader model 3.0+
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
